- Support L1/L2 underwriting decisions

- Backend API
- Relational database
- Document/file storage abstraction
- AI provider abstraction
- Authentication abstraction

- Audit logging

4. Define API boundaries.
5. Define frontend navigation.
6. Define role/permission architecture.
